description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Built-in downloader:** the offline player has an aspect ratio button: Fit (default), Stretch, Zoom (cropped) and Original (100%). The mode is shown in a toast, applies after turning the device and to the next video, and is remembered across restarts. It is hidden for audio-only downloads.
- **Built-in downloader:** the download cards in the offline library show the codec and format ID of a video (`1080p60 · 74 MB · VP9 · id: 303`) and the bitrate and format ID of an audio download (`Opus · 5,8 MB · 132kbps · id: 251`) in the accent color, and `Resume at` has its own line. Downloads from before this version keep their old text.

## Bug Fixes
- **YouTube - Built-in downloader:** the offline player and YouTube no longer play over each other. Starting a video pauses the offline player, and starting an offline track pauses the video. Silent feed previews leave the offline track alone, while Shorts pause it like any other video. The offline player also gives up the audio focus when it is paused, and a pause during a short focus loss (such as a call) no longer resumes it later.
- **YouTube - Built-in downloader:** the back, speed and aspect buttons of the offline player can be tapped in landscape again.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.17.0...v1.18.0)
